title: Game servers
intro: Whether the hall's game servers are up, how full they are and which map they run, asked every 30 seconds. The crew sends RCON commands from here.
empty: No game servers yet. An admin adds them here.
emptyAdmin: No game servers yet. Add one with its host and query port: Floorbit asks it like a server browser does.
noRcon: RCON is not set up for this server.
name: Name
rconHint: Optional. Kept encrypted and never shown again.
rconKept: A password is set. Leave this empty to keep it.
removeQuestion: Remove {{name}}? Its RCON password goes too.
consoleEmpty: Type a command, for example status. Every command goes into the audit log.
confirmText: {{command}} can stop the server, change the map or throw players out.
audited: Every command is in the audit log with your name.
